name: Trial sequences — any niche (the client's offer to the client's prospects)
source: Copy v2 (docs/research/v2-leads-copy.md): Sequence T structure (The 30-Day Trial, Section 10: plain text, no links in email 1, one reply CTA, four touches) with four frameworks. Wording is new and makes no claim about the client beyond {oneLiner} / {proof}; the client reviews it on the approval page.

problem-first.label: Problem first
problem-first.why: Names the most common reason the work waits (it slips behind the day-to-day), then one line on the offer, then an interest question.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, one more thought.

The cost of waiting is rarely obvious. It shows up as work that takes longer than it should.

Worth a short call to see if {ClientCompany} could help {Company} with it?

touches.subject: {niche} at {Company}
touches.body:
{FirstName}, a different angle.

Most {ICP} only look at {niche} when something forces it. It's easier to sort out while things are calm.

Would a 15-minute call next week be useful?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

question-led.label: Question led
question-led.why: Asks how they handle it today; either answer is easy to write back.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, I ask because your answer tells me if this is worth your time.

If it's covered and working, no need to change. If it sits with a busy person on your team, {ClientCompany} can take it on.

Which is it at {Company}?

touches.subject: question for {Company}
touches.body:
{FirstName}, one practical check.

It's worth knowing what {niche} costs {Company} today in time as well as money. Many {ICP} never add it up.

Want {ClientCompany} to help you work it out?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

quick-idea.label: Quick idea
quick-idea.why: Offers a short review to find one or two quick wins; the ask is to send what it covers.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, a review like this is quick to do and easy to put off.

{ClientCompany} can run it with you at a time that suits.

Would that be useful for {Company}?

touches.subject: idea for {Company}
touches.body:
{FirstName}, a second idea.

Most quick wins in {niche} come from one or two changes, not a big project.

Open to a 15-minute call to see which apply to {Company}?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

local-proof.label: Local proof
local-proof.why: Leads with one true proof line the client gave us (30MPC: social proof +41 % replies); used only when the profile has one.
